name: fred_continuing_claims
description:
The US continued unemployment insurance claims from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series CCSA (number of claims, weekly).
Returns {"series": "CCSA", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of newest observations; default 30).
Related: fred_initial_claims, fred_unemployment.
Example: {"limit": 12}

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
